reuse.why: The new Fintegra link goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and link.findOrCreateBank, and the new guards live in link.ts beside findOrCreateBank; but the takeover reimplements unlinkAccount's field reset and the download function copies the Enable Banking one.

duplication.why: The ensureAccountIsOpen + ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked pair is repeated in all six provider wrappers instead of once in a shared pre-link step, the unlink field reset is copied from unlinkAccount, and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadEnableBankingTransactions.

placement.why: Guards sit in accounts/link.ts, the type in its own types/models/fintegra.ts, server path and provider list where the others are; the unlink side effect hidden inside an 'ensure...' validator is the one misplaced piece.

scope.why: All edits serve the four requests: the guards, the replace flag, the Fintegra provider and their tests.

maintainability.why: Rules are centralized in two small functions, but a validator named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked that silently unlinks another account under a boolean flag is surprising, the unlink reset can drift from unlinkAccount, and each provider must remember to call both guards.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked (accounts/link.ts) clears account_id/bank/balances/sync source itself instead of going through the existing unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated pieces (guard calls per provider, unlink field reset, download function) are plain copies, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink added to LinkAccountBaseParams and to ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, which gains a replace branch performing an unlink; that branch re-implements unlinkAccount rather than calling it.
